SELECT * FROM biz_extension_class WHERE extension_class_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT dept_id FROM sys_dept WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_extension_class WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} AND entry_year=#{year} AND class_code=#{code})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND s.entry_year=#{year} AND s.class_code=#{code})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_lesson_assignment WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} AND entry_year=#{year} AND class_code=#{code})+ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_teacher_class WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} AND entry_year=#{year} AND class_code=#{code})

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_key='teacher') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur2 JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.role_id=ur2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id=u.user_id AND r2.role_key='researcher')

SELECT u.user_id,u.nick_name FROM sys_user u WHERE u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND r.role_key='teacher') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur2 JOIN sys_role r2 ON r2.role_id=ur2.role_id WHERE ur2.user_id=u.user_id AND r2.role_key='researcher')
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_extension_class SET status='ARCHIVED',update_time=NOW() WHERE extension_class_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ,m.join_time FROM biz_extension_class_member m JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=m.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE m.extension_class_id=#{id} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' ORDER BY s.entry_year,s.class_code,s.student_no

SELECT ,d.school_type,e.extension_class_id,e.class_name extension_class_name FROM biz_student s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=u.dept_id LEFT JOIN biz_extension_class_member m ON m.student_id=s.student_id LEFT JOIN biz_extension_class e ON e.extension_class_id=m.extension_class_id WHERE u.dept_id=#{deptId} AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_extension_class x WHERE x.dept_id=u.dept_id AND x.entry_year=s.entry_year AND x.class_code=s.class_code) AND (u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR s.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR CONCAT(s.entry_year,'级',s.class_code,'班') LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY s.entry_year DESC,s.class_code,s.student_no LIMIT 201
SELECT ,u.status,u.del_flag FROM biz_student s JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.student_id=#{studentId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT e.* FROM biz_extension_class_member m JOIN biz_extension_class e ON e.extension_class_id=m.extension_class_id AND e.status='ACTIVE' JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=m.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE m.student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT e.* FROM biz_extension_class_member m JOIN biz_extension_class e ON e.extension_class_id=m.extension_class_id AND e.status='ACTIVE' JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=m.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE m.student_id=#{studentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM biz_extension_class WHERE dept_id=#{deptId} AND entry_year=#{year} AND class_code=#{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM biz_extension_class_member WHERE extension_class_id=#{id} AND student_id=#{studentId}

DELETE m FROM biz_extension_class_member m LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=m.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE s.student_id IS NULL OR u.user_id IS NULL OR u.status!='0' OR u.del_flag!='0'
mapper.select: SELECT space_pref,space_selected FROM biz_student WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_student SET space_pref=#{space},space_selected=1 WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
UPDATE biz_student SET space_pref='regular',space_selected=0 WHERE student_id=#{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_extension_lesson_member(lesson_id,student_id,dept_id,create_time) SELECT #{lessonId},m.student_id,m.dept_id,NOW() FROM biz_extension_class_member m JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=m.student_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id AND u.status='0' AND u.del_flag='0' WHERE m.extension_class_id=#{id}

INSERT INTO biz_lesson_assignment(lesson_id,entry_year,class_code,assigner_id,dept_id,assign_time) VALUES(#{lessonId},#{entryYear},#{classCode},#{ownerId},#{deptId},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE lesson_id=VALUES(lesson_id),assigner_id=VALUES(assigner_id),assign_time=NOW(),auto_advance_ready_time=NULL
mapper.select: SELECT l.*,l.teacher_note remark FROM biz_extension_class e JOIN biz_lesson_assignment a ON a.dept_id=e.dept_id AND a.entry_year=e.entry_year AND a.class_code=e.class_code JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id=a.lesson_id AND l.extension_class_id=e.extension_class_id AND l.lesson_scope='extension' WHERE e.extension_class_id=#{id} AND e.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT l.*,l.teacher_note remark FROM biz_extension_class e JOIN biz_lesson_assignment a ON a.dept_id=e.dept_id AND a.entry_year=e.entry_year AND a.class_code=e.class_code JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id=a.lesson_id AND l.extension_class_id=e.extension_class_id AND l.lesson_scope='extension' WHERE e.extension_class_id=#{id} AND e.status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT lesson_id,lesson_scope,extension_class_id FROM biz_lesson WHERE lesson_id=#{lessonId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_extension_lesson_member WHERE lesson_id=#{lessonId} AND student_id=#{studentId}

SELECT sm.student_id,s.student_no,u.nick_name student_name,c.checkin_time FROM biz_extension_lesson_member sm LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON s.student_id=sm.student_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id LEFT JOIN biz_lesson_checkin c ON c.lesson_id=sm.lesson_id AND c.student_id=sm.student_id WHERE sm.lesson_id=#{lessonId} ORDER BY s.student_no,sm.student_id

SELECT l.lesson_title,c.checkin_time FROM biz_lesson_checkin c JOIN biz_lesson l ON l.lesson_id=c.lesson_id WHERE c.student_id=#{studentId} AND l.extension_class_id=#{id} ORDER BY c.checkin_time DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT lesson_id,lesson_title,lesson_date,lesson_scope FROM biz_lesson WHERE extension_class_id=#{id} ORDER BY lesson_id DESC
SELECT plan_id,plan_name,plan_scope FROM biz_python_practice_plan WHERE extension_class_id=#{id} ORDER BY plan_id DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO biz_extension_plan_member(plan_version_id,student_id,dept_id,create_time) SELECT v.plan_version_id,#{studentId},p.dept_id,NOW() FROM biz_python_practice_plan p JOIN biz_python_practice_plan_version v ON v.plan_id=p.plan_id AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.version_no=p.current_version_no WHERE p.extension_class_id=#{id} AND p.plan_scope='extension' AND p.status='ACTIVE'
